title: CC0 Jain text library (patron-library-collection / ganeshvarnilibrary)
author: various
notes: The largest legally-plausible Jain text trove found. Must be audited item by item: the CC0 tag is NOT credible for post-1966 publications, while pre-1966 works are PD by age regardless of the tag. Collection skews Digambara and generic-Jain, NOT Sthanakavasi. HIGHEST PRIORITY for the corpus-v0.1 ingest task.

title: Jain Dharma (1958)
author: Muni Sushil Kumar
copyright_status: 1958; pre-1966; PD pending author death-year check
notes: BEST SINGLE STHANAKAVASI SEED ITEM found. Publisher is explicitly the A.B.S. Sthanakvasi Jain Conference Bhavan, New Delhi. Verify the author death year to raise confidence, then promote to the core corpus.

title: An Illustrated Ardha Magadhi Dictionary Vol 1 (1923)
author: Muni Ratnachandraji
notes: Sthanakavasi-published Prakrit dictionary (Indore 1923). HIGHEST-VALUE PRAKRIT ASSET FOUND. Basis for the Ardhamagadhi lexicon used to validate all OCR output. Confirm the CC0 basis with counsel.

title: An Illustrated Ardha Magadhi Dictionary Vol 3 (1930)
author: Muni Ratnachandraji
notes: Bombay 1930. Exists as multiple CC0 uploads plus DLI copies. Resolve to one canonical instance in the dedup stage.

title: Ardha Magadhi Dictionary Vol 3 (1930) Lahore Jangamwadi Math copy
author: Shri Ratna Chandra Ji Maharaja
notes: Confirmed cross-uploader duplicate - the canonical example for the dedup stage. Prefer the better scan and record the pairing.

title: An Illustrated Ardha Magadhi Dictionary Vol 4 (1932)
author: Muni Ratnachandraji Maharaj
notes: Title explicitly names the S Sthanakwasi Jaina Conference as publisher. The duplicate DLI instance (in.ernet.dli.2015.327413) has no licence - use the CC0 one.

title: Ardha Magadhi Dictionary Vols 2 and 5 (1927; 1938)
author: Muni Ratnachandraji
notes: DLI items carry NO licenseurl, NO rights field and NO possible-copyright-status (verified). PD by age is likely but must be established per item. Hunt for CC0 instances of vols 2 and 5 before using these.

author: unknown translator
notes: The item's own text mentions 'Sthanakvasi' (found by Internet Archive full-text search), which suggests but does NOT prove Sthanakavasi provenance. 1966 is a boundary year - do not assume PD. Publisher attribution is the critical missing field.

title: Shri Dashvaikalik Sutra Ka Hindi Anuvad (1936)
author: unknown translator
notes: Mula-sutra memorised by all new Jain mendicants. High canonical value. Same publisher-attribution gap as the other DLI canon translations.

title: Shri Uttradhyayan Sutra Ka Hindi Anuvaad (1934)
author: unknown translator
notes: One of the oldest canon texts. TWO Hindi anuvadas exist (1934 and 1962) - separate works with separate rights. Never merge them.

title: Shri Uttradhyayan Sutra Ka Hindi Anuvaad (1962)
author: unknown translator
notes: Distinct edition from SVK-0013. Keep separately addressed so citations are unambiguous.

title: Shri Sutrakratang Sutra (1938)
author: unknown translator
notes: Second Anga; among the oldest texts in the canon.

title: Shri Utradhyayan Sutar (Agam Seva) (1920)
author: unknown

title: Shrimada Gyatadharmkathank Sutra (1964)
author: unknown
notes: Sixth Anga (parable collection). Good candidate for narrative-style instruction data IF rights are cleared.

title: Adhyatmik Pravachno Part-1 (1960)
author: unknown (pravachankar)
notes: Represents the pravachan genre, the tradition's living teaching form. Speaker identity is the key missing metadata.

title: Stavanavali (1960)
author: unknown
notes: Stavan (devotional song) collection. Stavans are shared across Jain traditions - do not label Sthanakavasi without evidence.

title: Subodh Jain Pathshala Part I (1964)
author: unknown
notes: Pathshala (religious school) textbook - precisely the kind of material the project needs and precisely the kind that is in copyright. A prime candidate for a permission request.

title: Jain Svetambara Agama Canon in English (with Hindi)
author: unknown community uploader
notes: Community upload of unknown provenance that may reproduce a copyrighted English translation set. SCOPE WARNING: Svetambara generally, not specifically Sthanakavasi. Do not use without identifying the underlying edition.

title: GRETIL - E-texts in Prakrit (bulk corpus)
author: MULTIPLE
license: none declared at site level; per-contribution rights
copyright_status: varies per text; likely PD editions
notes: THE MOST IMPORTANT TYPED PRAKRIT SOURCE found, and it removes OCR from the critical path. Verified: a Jaina section, a Prakrit section, a bulk 'Download All Prakrit Texts', and migration to TEI. NO site licence - rights are per contribution. Enumerate file by file and record each contributor.

title: GRETIL - Jaina texts in Sanskrit
author: MULTIPLE
notes: Includes late Sanskrit Jain philosophy from both Svetambara and Digambara authors - sect tagging must be done per text, never at the collection level.

title: dataspoof/Jains - Sastravarttasamuccaya
author: Haribhadrasuri
copyright_status: derived from GRETIL; upstream rights inherit
ocr_status: file is typed text; quality unknown
notes: Do NOT use this derivative for training. Source the plain text directly from GRETIL (SVK-0023) and record the contributor - i.e. remove the extra unlicensed layer.

title: shethjenil/JainBooks
author: MULTIPLE
notes: The dataset card carries NO source attribution and NO licence. Unknown provenance is disqualifying for training. Reachable only by contacting the uploader.

title: Atma3.1-ShareGPT (Atma Siddhi Shastra)
author: Shrimad Rajchandra
copyright_status: modern text; dataset licence is clear
notes: THE CLEANEST modern Jain instruction dataset found (7000+ lines, Apache-2.0). Tag GENERIC_JAIN, never Sthanakavasi. Verify whether the annotation layer is literal translation, interpretive summary, or contextual explanation before mixing into SFT.

title: Deshika - Maharashtri Prakrit to English Parallel Corpus
author: MULTIPLE
notes: The ONLY Prakrit-language dataset found on the Hub (language tag: pra). Value is as a translation fine-tuning signal and as a template for building the Ardhamagadhi parallel set. The language mismatch must be recorded, not glossed.

title: Jain Literature Open Repository (JLOR)
author: MULTIPLE
notes: VERIFIED: license NOASSERTION and pushed_at 2024-09-17 (dormant ~2 years). Contains AI-generated translations (Gemini 1.5 Flash, Claude Haiku per its own README). Unlicensed plus machine-translated means it cannot be trained on or redistributed. Approach the org for an explicit per-item licence grant.

title: Jainaagam - all 45 Jain Aagam
author: MULTIPLE
notes: VERIFIED: GitHub reports license null (all rights reserved) and pushed_at 2023-01-26 (dormant ~3.5 years). SCOPE WARNING: its own description says 45 Agamas = Murtipujaka canon. MUST be tagged MURTIPUJAKA_45, never Sthanakavasi. Highest-value POTENTIAL asset if a licence can be obtained.

title: Jain eLibrary
author: MULTIPLE
notes: Homepage is a JS app that renders no terms or licence text server-side (verified). Registration-gated. Under the standing rule that online availability is not permission, this library is OUT OF SCOPE until written permission is obtained. It is also the corpus behind JainGPT, so an agreement here would be strategically significant.

title: OPenn Jain manuscript collections (Ms. Indic 20, 25, 9, 15)
author: MULTIPLE

notes: Use for manuscript OCR/VLM research and layout/diagram work, NOT as a text corpus. Re-verify item-level rights before publishing anything derived.

author: MULTIPLE contributors

author: unknown
notes: NoDerivatives forbids normalisation, segmentation, correction and OCR cleaning - i.e. every step of our pipeline. Modern Jain texts under ND are structurally unusable regardless of quality.

title: chaturmas-suchi - Shri Vardhaman Sthanakvasi Jain Shraman Sangh
author: ankj77 (contributor)
notes: THE ONLY GitHub repository matching 'sthanakvasi' (verified: GitHub search total_count = 1). Not a corpus, but strategically valuable: it identifies a real active Sthanakvasi monastic order by name and provides monastic-placement metadata. Use it to seed institutional outreach.

title: JainGPT / JainQQ / AI-Yashvi
author: n/a
notes: Systems, not sources. Their corpora, licences, ranking methods and evaluation are undisclosed. Study their citation UX and failure modes; do NOT harvest their outputs into our corpus, which would import unlicensed and unverified text.

title: Jainendra Siddhanta Kosa Part 1 (1990)
author: K. Jinendra Varni
notes: THE CC0 TRAP WORKED EXAMPLE: an authoritative Jain encyclopaedia published in 1990 but tagged CC0 by a patron library. The tag is almost certainly invalid. Do not train on it. Illustrates why the manifest cannot trust uploader licence tags for modern works.

title: An Illustrated Ardha-Magadhi Dictionary Vol 1 (1923) university copy
author: Muni Ratnachandraji
notes: A third independent digitisation of the same volume (Karnataka Sanskrit University / ServantsOfKnowledge). Prefer the CC0 instance; keep this as a scan-quality cross-check and a dedup test case.

title: Notes on Modern Jainism (1910)
text_name: Notes on modern Jainism with special reference to the Svetambara Digambara and Sthanakavasi sects
author: Mrs. Sinclair Stevenson
notes: A 1910 English account that explicitly treats the Sthanakavasi sect. Useful as HISTORICAL SCHOLARSHIP for evaluation, and an early English-language description of the tradition. MUST be tagged as colonial-era Western scholarship, NOT as the tradition's own voice.
